FN-84W7EF2-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 117
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/25/2025
Senate Bill 117 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain sheriffs, by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the number of Class 1, 2, or 3 municipalities that enter
into memorandums of understanding with local sheriffs for traffic enforcement purposes.
However, any increased obligations could be offset, in whole or in part, by the distribution of
additional fees assessed for traffic violations and distributed to the respective local office of the
sheriff pursuant to this bill.
Page 1

FN-84W7EF2-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 117
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/26/2025
Senate Bill 117 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary could increase the obligations of
certain sheriffs, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of Class 1, 2, or 3
municipalities that enter into memorandums of understanding with local sheriffs and county
commissions for traffic enforcement purposes. However, any increased obligations could be
offset, in whole or in part, by the distribution of additional fees assessed for traffic violations
and distributed to the respective local office of the sheriff for law enforcement purposes only
pursuant to this bill.
